title: Boundary and cone property pass from S = [[L]] × S₀ to the factor S₀
statement:
Data:
- P, n ∈ ℕ; L ⊆ ℝ^P a linear subspace with 1 ≤ d := dim L < n; m := n − d.
- f = (f_1, …, f_d) an orthonormal family in L.
- S ∈ 𝒟_n(ℝ^P); S₀ ∈ 𝒟_m(ℝ^P) with an integer multiplicity representation R₀ = (M₀, θ₀, ζ₀) (IMRep univ m, R₀.Represents S₀) such that μ₀ := R₀.measure satisfies μ₀(ℝ^P ∖ L^⊥) = 0.
Hypothesis (product formula): for every map ♭ : Λ^n → Λ^m with (♭α)(v) = α(f_1, …, f_d, v_1, …, v_m) (Lean: α (Fin.append f v ∘ Fin.cast _)) and every test n-form ω,
 S(ω) = ∫_L currentEval S₀ (y ↦ ♭(ω(t + y))) dH^d(t), with H^d = μHE[d].
Conclusion: (∂S = 0 ⇒ ∂S₀ = 0) and (S a cone ⇒ S₀ a cone), i.e. (BoundaryVanishes S → BoundaryVanishes S₀) ∧ (IsConeCurrent S → IsConeCurrent S₀).
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (S : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n) (L : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (f : Fin (Module.finrank ℝ L) → Euclid P) (S₀ : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (n - Module.finrank ℝ L)) (R₀ : IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (n - Module.finrank ℝ L)) (hd : Module.finrank ℝ L < n), 0 < Module.finrank ℝ L → Orthonormal ℝ f → (∀ i, f i ∈ L) → R₀.Represents S₀ → R₀.measure (Lᗮ : Set (Euclid P))ᶜ = 0 → (∀ flat : Covector (Euclid P) n → Covector (Euclid P) (n - Module.finrank ℝ L), (∀ (α : Covector (Euclid P) n) (v : Fin (n - Module.finrank ℝ L) → Euclid P), flat α v = α (Fin.append f v ∘ Fin.cast (Nat.add_sub_of_le hd.le).symm)) → ∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n, S ω = ∫ t in (L : Set (Euclid P)), currentEval S₀ (fun y => flat ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) (t + y))) ∂μHE[Module.finrank ℝ L]) → (BoundaryVanishes S → BoundaryVanishes S₀) ∧ (IsConeCurrent S → IsConeCurrent S₀)
